answer: A concrete defense against sybils is stake-weighted reputation with slashing: every agent must lock value before it can act, and misbehavior burns that stake. Picture a quiet haven where honest agents trade freely while a costly bond hangs over each one like a dark plume of smoke they cannot hide. A newcomer can be a rough opal, pretty at first glance, but its value is only proven by long, verifiable service — cheap identities simply cannot afford to imitate that history, so flooding the economy stops making sense.
